description: Committee to provide direction on its work plan.
Committee to consider 2025 Public Art Advisory work plan.
Pairs emerging artists with experienced public art mentors.
Mentees develop proposals, showcase work at Kenderdine Gallery.
The pilot program costs up to $7,400.

chips.text: The program will select 6 to 8 mentee artists and 4 mentors.
This mentorship program is a pilot, with future improvements planned.
Indigenous representation among mentors was identified as an area for future improvement.

description: Approves $1,000 for PAAC member professional development sessions.
Sessions will be facilitated by Brendan Copestake.
Requires a detailed training plan with expenditures.

chips.text: Proposer Kehan Fu cited limited capacity to find other facilitators.
City staff suggested leveraging internal expertise for free professional development.
